# three.js (vendored)

`three.min.js` is the unmodified UMD build of [three.js](https://threejs.org/)
r128, vendored locally so the panel works without any external CDN (HACS
integrations should not depend on internet access from the end user's
browser at runtime).

License: MIT, Copyright 2010-2021 Three.js Authors.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/build/three.min.js
